name: astra-advisor
description: Codex-native dynamic orchestration with GPT-6 Astra as the primary advisor.

interface.shortDescription: Use GPT-6 Astra to plan, route, verify, and review work dynamically.
interface.longDescription: Astra Advisor keeps GPT-6 Astra in the primary session at the effort selected by the user. Astra can combine useful parent work with bounded native Codex subagents, preferring gpt-6-astra and gpt-5.6-luna with a supported effort from live tool metadata. A delegation hook advises on missing explicit controls without blocking or rewriting calls. ChatGPT Work cloud tasks remain bounded by the create_thread schema and do not promise arbitrary model or effort pinning.
defaultPrompt: Use $astra-advisor:orchestration to plan, build, verify, and review this work.
Choose dynamic subagents only when bounded independent work improves delivery.
